0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets (7-2, first in the Southwest, 3rd in the West) are on a one-game losing streak after going 3-1 on the road, and they are 4-1 at home. The Phoenix Suns (1-5, on a four-game losing streak) are 12th in the West and third in the Pacific, 4.5 games back. Houston won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026, and the 2026-27 series has no games yet; Steven Adams is out for the Rockets with a calf strain, Clint Capela is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, and Mark Williams is out for Phoenix after shoulder surgery.
